messages:
Zara M: Customer (PulseBank) sent final traffic: peak ~6k req/min chat (baseline ~2k/min), occasional embed batch windows up to ~12k/min for 5-10m. Req: p99 chat <200ms, wants predictable monthly cost and answers to security questionnaire (VPC peering, customer KMS, audit logs). Need a recommended reserved GPU plan + autoscale knobs and POC plan.
Devon P: Quick convert: 6k/min = 100 RPS baseline, bursts to 200 RPS. Models: chat -> redwood-2-7b (q4_0), embeds -> embed-lite.
Rohan S: Benchmark note: redwood-2-7b at ~320 tokens (256 in + 64 out) yields ~120-150 RPS per A100-80GB equiv when q4_0 + batching + KV cache. Embeds ~1.2k/min per GPU.
Devon P: Recommend separating pools. Proposal: reserve 2 chat GPUs (covers baseline+headroom) + 1 embed GPU. Add autoscale policy to allow bursting up to +3 GPUs across pools. Suggest burst-credit bucket (e.g., 150 GPU-hours/mo) for predictable overage.
Zara M: What about p99 risk during embed windows?
Rohan S: Keep embed pool isolated. Also require a 5-10m scheduled preheat for embed batches to warm KV cache (saves ~20-30% compute). For chat, enable prefix caching and continuous batching.
Devon P: Autoscale snippet we usually send customers:
```
metric: chat_rps
scale_up: { threshold: 140, add: 1, cooldown: 60 }
scale_down: { threshold: 80, remove: 1, cooldown: 120 }
max_replicas: 5
```
Rohan S: Tune scale_up to where p95 starts to slope (140-160). Use p95/p99 latency as control plane metric.
Zara M: Security Qs answered?
Presales Bot: SOC2 report: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2.pdf
Presales Bot: VPC peering guide: https://redwood.example.com/private/vpc-peering
Presales Bot: KMS options: hosted (managed) or private deployment with customer-managed KMS.
Devon P: I'll take the security questionnaire (KMS/VPC/audit). Rohan, can you draft the POC runbook (traffic lanes, expected metrics, preheat steps)?
Rohan S: Yes. Recommend 3-day POC: two lanes - (1) chat steady + synthetic spikes to validate autoscale & p99, (2) embed batch lane with scheduled preheat and KV warm to validate throughput. SRE monitoring slot required.
Zara M: Pricing: propose 12mo commit for 2 chat GPUs + 1 embed GPU at committed discount (~30%), burst credits meter monthly, overage at on-demand. Include clause for scheduled batch windows to avoid surprise overage.
Devon P: I'll draft pricing + contract bullets and post by EOD Friday. Zara please attach the questionnaire answers when done. :thumbsup:
